headline_finding: Firing frequency tiers the rules, but the pre-registered output-change metric is ~0 for every rule except J: the safeguards are ADVISORY and do not feed the graded directional calls. So 'strong-rules-only accuracy' == 'full accuracy' for the ordinality family (removing advisory rules changes nothing); the durability signal rests on J alone, which is Structural.

A.demotion_criteria: retire / downgrade if a FALSIFIED case appears in its firing set
